list._baseAcceptanceValue: actor will always accept when their own AI decide to go to sleep, so this value is only checked if they were invited by someone else to sleep. Currently they'll lose consciousness when touching bed, but in the future i would like to extend this command into masturbation sex command or straight up sex. Instead of making them unable to act for the whole duration, make it so they'll prefer to stay in bed but nothing stops them from having sex or toilet or wander into someone else's room. or make it so their sleep consciousness mod fluctuate

variants._comments: sleep together - also 'sleep with' the bed's sleepers (Job_Furniture.MakePackages puts them as receivers, Docs/Furniture/Plan_FurnitureOccupancy.md). doerCount above 9 = no actor count limit, the bed's capacity is the limit

list._comments: going into a room divider (stall, private bathroom) - added by code to every furniture whose occupancy isRoomDivider (Job_Furniture.UpdateAllUsableCOMs), offered only from outside. Inside, the divider's own commands are reachable and the rest of the room is not. Temporary transit step (ActionPackage_DividerMove); the effect is applied on completion by the dividerEnter tag. The player's move is never refused: followers are its receivers (one who can't come stops following, named in the tooltip / log), a current target not following is first asked along with a real 同行 resolved on click - its rate is the command's rate. Docs/Furniture/Plan_FurnitureOccupancy.md §4

coming out of a room divider - offered only from inside, not while in a sex scene. Moving to another room needs it first (always explicit). Same mechanics as com_furniture_divider_enter (followers, 同行 invite).
all COM with sleep tag are hard-coded to allow character without sleep need to recover 1HP and 1MP on command completion
all COM with sleep tag are hard-coded to allow character without sleep need to recover 1HP and 1MP on command completion

Bed rest compelled by an abnormal condition (labor, post-birth / post-op recovery). Only valid while the doer requireBedRest. Pure time advance, no stat results. Natural birth only happens while the mother is executing a rest_required or rest COM (ReproductionUtility.CanBirthNow). Tags match beds' comTags [furniture, bed]; non-tag beds (hospital, netcafe) list it by comID. Beds only - never add it to tables/sofas.

list._comment: Revived from the stripped placeholder com_job_training_shooting (do_not_use, COM_job.json) as a location-agnostic recreation command (Docs/Utnapishtim_Activities/Plan_UtnapishtimActivities.md §6): any furniture giving comTags [furniture, training_shooting] offers it (furniture_shooting_range_spot), usable in normal sandbox anywhere; the house activity 'shooting_training' finds its lanes by this tag (RecreationFacility.comTag). Solo or pair. No experience yet: experience_combat has no ExperienceClass entry (ExperienceDefs/Experiences.json).

Revived from the stripped placeholder com_job_training_melee (see com_furniture_training_shooting): given by comTags [furniture, training_melee] (furniture_arena_spot). doerCount 1 = solo practice, 2 = sparring with a partner. No experience yet (experience_combat has no ExperienceClass entry).

Music practice on any furniture giving comTags [furniture, music_practice] (furniture_stage) - solo or a band, usable in normal sandbox anywhere; the house activity 'music_practice' holds the stage's whole room (RecreationFacility reserve Room). No experience yet (experience_perform has no ExperienceClass entry).

A physical checkup: the doer examines the receiver, on any furniture giving comTags [furniture, medical_checkup] (furniture_hospital_bed). No effect of its own. Sandbox only - the checkup activity's Job_Checkup runs its own job command (checkup_examination, COM_Defs/COM_Recreation/checkup.json - like jp_hospital_csection_operation). Not a recreation command.

zh-cn.com_furniture_sleep:
玩家只有在可睡眠时间段（默认为23H-6H）才可睡眠，可以在阵营管理-工作分配界面检查玩家的时间表确认。
该指令执行后，参与者会获得时长等于参与者自身%%stats_derived_sleepNeed%%分钟的睡眠状态。当该状态结束时角色会立刻醒来
zh-cn.com_furniture_sleep_begin_2: $doer.firstname$关掉床头灯后缓缓闭上眼睛
zh-cn.com_furniture_takingBreak: 休息一下，缓解角色压力
zh-cn.com_furniture_takingLongBreak: 缓解角色压力的同时，还会回复HP，代价是耗时翻倍
zh-cn.com_furniture_rest_required: 因分娩、产后或术后等状况，必须卧床静养时才能执行
zh-cn.com_furniture_prison_ADD: 将对象监禁在此处（无法自由行动），且只能与此处的家具互动
zh-cn.com_furniture_prison_REMOVE: 将监禁于此处的对象释放
zh-cn.com_furniture_restroom_fix:
当角色有衣物被脱下后可执行。指令结束时角色会穿上所有衣物
NPC如果衣冠不整，会优先寻找合适的地点（有卫生间的地点）穿衣
zh-cn.com_furniture_changeOutfit:
当角色当前的安排（阵营身份或活动）要求换上另一套服装时可执行。指令结束时角色会换上该安排的服装，或换回默认服装
NPC会在需要时前往有卫生间的地点换衣
zh-cn.com_furniture_getmeal_begin_1: $doer.firstname$在桌边坐下，拿起一份$name$吃了起来。
zh-cn.com_furniture_training_shooting_begin_1: $doer.firstname$站到射击位置，戴上耳罩，举起手中的武器，开始了今天的训练
zh-cn.com_furniture_training_shooting_begin_2: $doer.firstname$调整呼吸，瞄准靶心，扣动扳机，开始了精准射击的练习
zh-cn.com_furniture_training_shooting_begin_3: $doer.firstname$在射击场上，反复练习着各种射击姿势，提高自己的射击水平
zh-cn.com_furniture_training_melee_begin_1: $doer.firstname$站在训练场中央，深吸一口气，摆出格斗姿势，开始了今天的近身格斗训练
zh-cn.com_furniture_training_melee_begin_2: $doer.firstname$反复练习着各种进攻和防御的动作，提升自己的格斗能力
zh-cn.com_furniture_music_practice_begin_1: $doer.firstname$调好乐器，开始了今天的练习
zh-cn.com_furniture_music_practice_begin_2: $doer.firstname$对着乐谱，一遍遍练习着不熟练的段落
zh-cn.com_furniture_medical_checkup_begin_1: $doer.firstname$让$receiver.firstname$在检查床上躺好，开始了体检
zh-cn.com_furniture_medical_checkup: 为目标做一次体检。需要检查床。

en-us.com_furniture_sleep:
Sleep. Can be executed only during sleep hours (for Player, default value is 23H-6H, can be confirmed in Player Schedules in Management-Work Assignment tab)
On execution, every participant will fall into sleep status with duration equal to %%stats_derived_sleepNeed%% in minutes, and will wake up on status removal
en-us.com_furniture_sleep_begin_2: $doer.firstname$ turned off the bedside lamp and slowly closed their eyes
en-us.com_furniture_rest_required: Only available when the character must stay on bed rest (labor, postpartum or post-op recovery)
en-us.com_furniture_cryosleep_begin_1_ADD: $doer.firstname$ starts putting $receiver.firstname$ into the cryosleep device
en-us.com_furniture_prison_begin_1_ADD: $doer.firstname$ starts imprisoning $receiver.firstname$ into the holding cell
en-us.com_furniture_prison_onComplete_1_ADD: $receiver.firstname$ is being jailed in the cell
en-us.com_furniture_prison_begin_1_REMOVE: $doer.firstname$ tries releasing $receiver.firstname$ from the holding cell
en-us.com_furniture_restroom_fix:
Can be performed when target has removed clothing. Target will redress everything on command completion.
NPC will try to find a private spot first before attempting to redress.
en-us.com_furniture_getmeal_begin_1: $doer.firstname$ sat down at the table, picked up a portion of $name$ and began to eat.
en-us.com_furniture_getmeal_begin_2: $doer.firstname$ brought the $name$ closer and began eating.
en-us.com_furniture_takingBreak: Take a break to relieve character stress
en-us.com_furniture_takingLongBreak: Relieves character stress and recovers HP, at the cost of double the time
en-us.com_furniture_prison_ADD: Imprison the target here (unable to move freely), can only interact with furniture in this location
